Original notify_order creates a sell StopTrail after every completed BUY and a buy StopTrail after every completed SELL, without limiting this behavior to initial entries. These new orders are not assigned to self.order. A trailing exit can therefore create an opposite pending trailing entry while flat; ordinary entry logic can also act.

Original is two-sided with RSI14 and volumeSMA7 entry qualifiers, OBV/SMA30 crosses and2% trailing orders. A simple long-entry/one-source-exit cash adapter would omit part of the original callback lifecycle. New pending-order/reversal/cancel/fill semantics and synthetic native order proofs would be required before any declaredSpotadaptation.
